title: proof.flag
description: Phase 4 cross-cutting: emitted by scrapers, categorizer, processors and (later) proofreaders to surface anomalies that should not silently degrade the pipeline. The shape is intentionally loose because each producer adds its own context fields under the same envelope; only `kind` is universally required.

kind.description: Stable, low-cardinality classifier of the anomaly.

target.description: URL or path that produced the artefact.

detail.description: Free-form human-readable diagnostic. Capped at 1024 chars by producers (third-pass audit C3); over-long values are truncated, not rejected.

processor.description: Producer agent name when emitted by a processor.

agent.description: Producer agent name when emitted by other agents.
